rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: PVR INOX Limited has informed the exchange about opening of 3 new screens at Soul Space Spirit, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka.

rows.title: Buyback
rows.summary: PVR INOX Limited has submitted to Stock Exchange the Letter of offer for Buy-back of equity shares.

rows.title: News Verification
rows.summary: The Exchange has sought clarification from PVR INOX Limited with respect to recent news item captioned PVR Inox shares fall 8% amid internal probe into alleged Rs 200-crore kickbacks.  The response from the Company is attached.
